[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Caramoan Islands, Camarines Sur - a group of islands with stunning beaches, lagoons, and rugged rock formations.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. White Island, Camiguin - a small uninhabited island with powdery white sand and crystal clear waters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Sabang Beach, Puerto Galera, Mindoro - a picturesque beach with clear waters and beautiful coral reefs for snorkeling and diving.
